description: Shared $defs referenced by other schemas in this directory via $ref (e.g. "common.schema.json#/$defs/Paragraph"). Not a data file's own shape on its own -- nothing assigns a global matching this file directly.

ConfigPart.description: One inline styled run in a SITE_CONFIG.tagline/license array or inside a Paragraph's `parts`. `strong` is rendered by Footer.dc.html (credits/license/disclosures) but NOT by FAQ.dc.html's own paragraph mapper -- avoid `strong` inside a FAQ_ITEMS[].a paragraph even though this shared type allows it there too.

Paragraph.description: One rendered paragraph in CREDITS, SITE_CONFIG.disclosures, or a FAQ_ITEMS[].a entry -- a bare string (one plain paragraph), or a `{parts}` envelope for a paragraph built from styled runs.
